verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Browserbase lets developers control headless browser sessions programmatically through its own SDK and Stagehand. However, no item names Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or Scrapy, or documents connecting those open-source libraries to Browserbase sessions. Generic 'full browser control' language cannot be credited as support for specific third-party library compatibility, so this applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build scrapers using popular open-source automation libraries like Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or Scrapy
